Units are controlled on the local network only; no cloud login is used. A login can be added later with Reconfigure.

confirm_addresses.title: Confirm unit addresses

cn105.title: CN105 telemetry (experimental)
cn105.description: Reads extra telemetry over the unit's CN105 bus through the adapter. Experimental: only one local client should talk to a unit. This can be changed later in the integration options.

data_description.cn105_codes:
- **0x03**: Outdoor temperature, Return air temperature and Compressor runtime sensors. The runtime counter may count unit on-time rather than compressor time.
- **0x09**: Sub mode and Fan stage sensors, plus defrost, preheat, standby and auto heat/cool detection for the HVAC action.
- **0x06**: Compressor frequency sensor, plus compressor running for the Compressor sensor and HVAC action. Some units stop answering CN105 until the adapter reboots.

The Compressor sensor needs 0x06.

fan_park.title: Smart control
fan_park.description:
Active for: {enabled}

The toggles below are the defaults for units without their own settings. Pick a unit to tune it, opt it out, or return it to these defaults.

data_description.smart_fan: Sets the fan speed from how far the room is from the setpoint, quietest at the setpoint and highest at the full speed distance. Adds a Dynamic fan mode to the climate entity; choosing any other speed hands control back.
data_description.enabled: Powers the unit off once the room is past the setpoint, so the indoor fan stops instead of running at setpoint, and powers it back on in the same mode when the room drifts back.
data_description.unit: Optional. Opens that unit's settings after saving the defaults.

fan_park_unit.title: Smart control
fan_park_unit.description: Unit {unit}. A remote temperature sensor is recommended, because the unit's own reading is unreliable while its fan is slow or stopped.

data_description.use_defaults: Clears this unit's own settings so it follows the all-units defaults. Turn off to use the settings below.

fan.name: Dynamic fan control
fan.description: Sets the fan speed from how far the room is from the setpoint: the quietest speed at the setpoint, the highest at the full speed distance.

data_description.smart_fan: Adds a Dynamic fan mode to the climate entity. Choosing it hands the speed to Home Assistant; choosing any other speed hands it back.
data_description.full_speed_at: Distance from the setpoint at which the highest speed is used.
data_description.fan_hysteresis: How far past a speed band edge the room must get before the speed steps down.
data_description.fan_hold: The fan speed changes at most once in this time.

auto_off.name: Automatic off
auto_off.description: Powers the unit off once the room has passed the setpoint by the off margin, and back on when it drifts past the restart margin. To stop the unit, turn it off from Home Assistant: an off from the remote cannot be seen while the unit is held off, and it would be restarted later.

data_description.off_margin: How far past the setpoint the room must be before the unit is powered off.
data_description.restart_margin: How far the room may drift back past the setpoint before the unit is powered on again.
data_description.dwell: How long the room must stay past the off margin.
data_description.idle_dwell: Used instead while the unit reports standby or a stopped compressor (0x06), if shorter.
data_description.min_on: The unit runs at least this long after it is powered on.
data_description.min_off: The unit stays off at least this long.
data_description.enabled: Powers the unit off once the room is past the setpoint, so the indoor fan stops instead of running at setpoint, and powers it back on in the same mode when the room drifts back.
